quote: The SuperNEMO modules will use the 8-in. R5912-MOD Hamamatsu PMTs. For cost effectiveness NUVIA CZ PS scintillator has been chosen.

In the 144Ce-144Pr experiment the two order of magnitude lower attainable activity suggests to deploy the source both externally at 7.15 m from the center (within the water tank, Phase B) or, even better, within the detector itself (Phase C).
